description:
In the wake of the Belmont clan disappearing from history,
the Order of Ecclesia was formed to combat Dracula should he arise again.
Bearing the glyph of Dominus, will Shanoa be able to defeat him?

cvooe1.0.description:
# Castlevania: Order of Ecclesia Archipelago Version 1.0 #
* Initial Release
## Base Game Changes ##
 - Areas are unlocked through Map items instead of finishing other areas
 - You start with a Magical Ticket and can use them infinitely
 - Wygol Village is always accessible
  - The exit tunnel of Large Cavern has been extended to not need slide.
  - Albus in Mystery Manor is now just a regular check and has no ties to the ending; your villager count has no bearing on it.
  - Some cutscenes have been removed for technical purposes
 - To trigger Barlowe's fight and acccess the castle;
    - You must enter his room with the 3 pieces of Dominus.
    - If your villager goal is not met, you will get the bad ending and be told how many total villagers you need
    - If your villager goal is not met, the ending will not trigger unless you have Glyph  Union to prevent softlocking.

## Known Issues ##
N/A
cvooe1.0.title: Castlevania: Order of Ecclesia Archipelago v1.0

cvooe1.1.description:
# Castlevania: Order of Ecclesia Archipelago Version 1.1 #
## New Settings ##
* ``Add No Hit Chests``: Adds the No-Hit Boss Medal chests as checks. If you miss getting a medal chest, you can refight the boss by entering a portal in its room after defeating it.
* ``Barlowe Required``: Requires you to defeat Barlowe before Dracula can be fought. This won't be noticable unless the Castle is open by default.
* ``AP Multiplier``: Multiplier for the amount of AP dropped by enemies. Only affects AP given by enemies.
* ``One-Screen Mode``: Allows playing on one screen. Use ``Select`` to view the map.
* ``Open Castle``: Opens access to Dracula's Castle by default
## Changes ##
* Entering Brachyura's room without any vertical movement now automatically teleports you out of the room so that you don't get stuck there
* A handful of slide checks are now in logic with Arma Felix
* Receiving any Glyph from any check now gives +1 to all AP like absorbing glyphs normally does
* Ledge checks in Oblivion Ridge now in logic with only double jump
* Generator Puzzle in logic with only regular Fulgur
## Fixes ##
* Money glyphs now display the item as G instead of $
* Fixed Barlowe's Albus 2 dialogue taking priority over the Dominus check
* Fixed a vanilla softlock when entering the Minera Prison Island boss room while flying
* Removed a vanilla duplicate chest that would cause a minor graphical discrepency on the Final Stash Second From Left Chest
* Fixed the Mechanical Tower Generator Puzzle glyph being broken
* Fixed Oblivion Ridge's albus cutscene showing the wrong glyph
## Known Issues ##
* None so Far
cvooe1.1.title: Castlevania: Order of Ecclesia Archipelago v1.1

cvooe1.2.description:
# Castlevania: Order of Ecclesia Archipelago Version 1.2 #
## New Settings ##
* ``Randomize Glyph Attributes``: Randomizes the Attributes of Glyphs. Can either be Chaotic (per glyph) or Consistent (across types/unions). Guranteed to have Lightning for the Generator and non-Slash for tin man
* ``Randomize Stolen Glyphs``: Randomizes the Glyphs that can be absorbed from enemies mid-attack. Can be any local glyph or a multiworld check with Glyphsanity.
* ``Randomize Dropped Glyphs``: Randomizes Glyphs dropped by enemies. Can be any local glyph or a multiworld check with Glyphsanity.
* ``Glyph Drop Rate Multiplier``: Multiplier for enemies' Glyph drop rates 
* ``Deathlink``: Deathlink
## Changes ##
* Minera Prison Island Tin Man chest is now in logic with any non-slash Glyph
* Enemy Glyphs now only appear on their status page after absorbing their Glyph instead of simply owning any copy of it
* Enemy Glyphs are now assigned to the location groups of each area they appear in rather than a single [Enemy Glyphs] group
* Nitesco is now logical for the Monastery Cubes glyph
* Relics on glyphs now have a unique icon from regular items
* The cats that can be rescued (except for Anna's cat) will now give vague hints on where to find some major items.
## Fixes ##
* Fixed Minera Prison Island Right Vertical Chest not being assigned to the final part
* Fixed AP data occasionally getting overwritten if the client was connected before being in-game
* Melio Ascia and Umbra added as generatable Filler glyphs
* Fixed being unable to back out of the difficulty selection menu
## Known Issues ##
* None so Far
cvooe1.2.title: Castlevania: Order of Ecclesia Archipelago v1.2

cvooe1.3.description:
# Castlevania: Order of Ecclesia Archipelago Version 1.3 #
## New Settings ##
* ``Randomize Castle Doors``: Shuffles the area transition doors in the Castle
* ``Save on Area Exit``: Automatically fully heals you and autosaves when you exit to the World Map.
* ``Logic Tricks``: Various tricks that you can put into logic. The list of tricks can be viewed at <https://github.com/PinkSwitch/Archipelago/blob/order-of-ecclesia/worlds/cv_ooe/docs/logic_tricks.md>
* ``Shuffle Enemy Drops``: Randomizes items that enemies drops
* ``Weight Drops``: If enemy drops are shuffled, drops will be weighted to their rarity, meaning rare drops are more likely to be good items.
## Changes ##
* Reduced the number of blocks that need to be destroyed for the Monastery Cubes Chest to 1/4 of the normal amount
* Mystery Manor main access is now in logic with Arma Felix
* Death's No-Hit chest now logically expects Slide
* Minera Prison Island: Right Vertical Hidden Item is now in logic with Redire
* Added Fire and Light + Dark Unions to the Monastery Cube glyph logic
## Fixes ##
* Fixed some slash Glyphs not being marked as Progression
## Known Issues ##
* None so Far
